user.title: Apple IR Receiver
user.description: Select the Apple IR receiver (hidraw device) to use.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Apple IR Receiver
reconfigure.description: Select the hidraw device for the receiver, e.g. if its /dev/hidraw* path has changed.

abort.no_devices_found: No Apple IR receiver found via hidraw. Make sure the receiver is connected/passed through and /dev/hidraw* is accessible.

error.device_not_found: The selected receiver is no longer available. Select another receiver.

device_unavailable.title: Apple IR receiver is unavailable
device_unavailable.description: Check that the receiver is connected or passed through to Home Assistant and that Home Assistant can read its /dev/hidraw device. The integration will retry automatically.

device_selection_required.title: Select an Apple IR receiver
device_selection_required.description: Multiple Apple IR receivers were found, but the configured receiver could not be identified. Open Settings > Devices & services, find Apple IR Receiver, and select Reconfigure to choose a receiver.
